title: Fixed Open Grid Plate Waffle Machine
description: One original complete fixed-open countertop waffle-machine appearance. A broad chamfered casing on four grounded feet carries a whole lower mould plate with twenty-five true finite square recesses. A matching complete upper mould plate is fixed raised ninety-five degrees with its gridded face visible, seated on a thick lid casing and connected by two rear hinge stands and one complete horizontal pin. A wide whole lifting bridge reaches around the upper front edge; two small blank control dials belong to the lower fascia. Three opaque untextured PBR roles. New complete geometry, not the two-slot toaster relabelled or a miniature front-loading oven. One prop and zero scenes; no food, cord, heating element, animated hinge, cooking instructions, thermal performance, powered operation, food-contact or safety claim.
